answer: A sybil-resistant economy can grow trust like a reef: every identity accumulates a reef of peer-attested useful-work receipts, each anchored to a public knoll checkpoint hash, so receipts cannot be copied between identities or replayed across epochs. At each dawn every identity must re-attest a fresh slice of recent work, and its oldest receipts decay, so standing still erodes standing. A sybil farm can fake one reef cheaply, but keeping a hundred reefs alive means paying real, fresh, per-identity work at every dawn, while honest agents maintain one reef with the work they already do.
